steps.note: Arakawa after the split (no forward-post talk): his 02:10 call at the gate plays once with the telescope and the Malhotra interruption, then the daughter and the road (with the Helena line after a finished m09) and 'Hold it'.

said: Arakawa steps up beside you at the gate and dials.
She wants a telescope. I'm getting her a telescope.
Holding the gate. Nothing's come up the road.
The sheriff closed it. Nobody asked who for.
